summary: Heavy cookware sits resting on soft cloth near the counter edge.

hazards.title: Cookware Near Counter Edge
hazards.detail: Heavy Dutch oven resting on loose cloth near the edge poses a pull or tip hazard.
fixSteps: Push pots toward the center of the island away from walking edges.
Use dedicated silicone trivets rather than folded fabric towels.

hazards.title: Loose Pot Lid on Island
hazards.detail: Heavy ceramic lid placed flat near the edge could slip or get knocked off.
fixSteps: Store lid securely on top of pot or place on a dedicated stand.
Keep loose lids further back from countertop edges.

products.name: Silicone Heat Resistant Trivets
products.reason: Prevents hot cookware from slipping on smooth countertop surfaces.
